headline: War Day 508: Six Fronts Rage Amid Heavy Losses
war_summary: Three hours on, the battlefield has sharpened around six corridors. Weathered Expanse now leads with forty‑five ownership flips in the last day, the latest hour recording roughly 750 Colonial and 1,500 Warden casualties per hour while enlistments climb to seventy per hour; both casualty trends are still accelerating. Callahans Passage remains a meat‑grinder, logging thirty‑five flips and a two‑hour toll of 2,050 Colonial and 1,680 Warden losses, with hourly rates surging past 1,200 and 960 respectively. Nevish Line has steadied at twenty‑three flips but its hourly casualty pace has risen to 540 Colonial and 830 Warden, both accelerating. Stlican Shelf mirrors that intensity with twenty‑two flips and hourly losses of 170 Colonial and 235 Warden, also accelerating. Palantine Berm has erupted as a new hotspot, posting twenty flips and a two‑hour spike of 202 Colonial and 192 Warden casualties, the hourly trend now near 200 each. Stonecradle has awakened modestly, twelve flips and a rising hourly toll of 55 Colonial and 155 Warden. Elsewhere the map remains locked under single‑faction control with only low‑level attrition.
